principle: The released product definition is a canonical semantic layer. Native MBD/DimXpert is the preferred machine-readable carrier, but absence of authored PMI does not force a second manual truth if a characteristic is explicitly bound to native CAD semantics plus controlled parameters/specification.
drawing_rule: A drawing characteristic may be generated only from an accepted authority state. A drawing is a representation of product definition and cannot promote an OPEN or ambiguous characteristic.
mbd_migration_rule: Reviewed semantic bindings remain traceable migration targets for later native DimXpert authoring; they are not silent fallbacks.
